WITH spatial_projects AS (
  SELECT sp.arcref, p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial sp
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
funding_counts AS (
  SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM spatial_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_records,
    COUNT(*) as num_sources,
    SUM(record_count)::numeric / COUNT(*) as avg_count
  FROM funding_counts
)
SELECT 
  fc.fundflux,
  fc.record_count as count,
  fc.record_count::numeric / s.total_records as share,
  fc.record_count - s.avg_count as excess
FROM funding_counts fc
CROSS JOIN summary s
WHERE fc.record_count > s.avg_count
ORDER BY fc.record_count DESC;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in fundflux (if present) are treated as a distinct funding source and included in the grouping and average calculation
The average count is calculated as total spatial records across all funding sources divided by the number of distinct funding sources (not the mean of any pre-existing distribution)
